limitations: Stationary finite-state chain, L at least 3, one vacancy, fixed positive site rates; no infinite-volume or arbitrary-density result. Novelty priority remains qualified by potential unindexed earlier structural classifications.
scientific_integrity: The new claim is restricted to the one-vacancy disordered exclusion ring. Its current formula specializes the classical unicyclic Markov-walk theorem; the new content is the necessary-and-sufficient exact bias symmetry characterization, its four-site factorization, the accidental full-symmetry family, and the sharp four-site threshold. No infinite-system assertion or unperformed validation is claimed.
title: Exact one-vacancy bias symmetry and accidental reversibility on disordered exclusion rings
